Repair wrapt.lru_cache classmethod handling so actual calling class participates in shared cache keys rather than capturing first bound method. Both @lru_cache/@classmethod orders, Base/Derived calls in either order and instance access must return actual cls. Keep ordinary per-instance cache isolation/GC, static/plain functions, cache_info/cache_parameters and shared class cache_clear behavior. Class-key references follow normal functools retention until eviction/clear; do not claim weak class storage.

Add explicit wrapt.weak_cache.weak_method_cache(maxsize=128,typed=False) using real wrapt descriptor/decorator binding and WeakFunctionProxy. Maintain id+weakref-verified per-instance caches without requiring instance hash/equality or __dict__; weak callbacks remove exact matching entry, bound methods must not strongly retain instance. Thread-safe cache creation, no singleflight promise. Cached result or arguments that themselves retain self follow normal retention and are excluded from weak-lifetime guarantee. Existing lru_cache unchanged.

Add explicit wrapt.async_cache.async_lru_cache(maxsize=128) for coroutine functions, storing only successful completed values in per-running-loop bounded LRU. Repeat await same call works, exceptions and cancellation never cache; clear during in-flight compute advances generation so its later success returns only to caller without repopulating cleared cache. Expose current-loop cache_info/cache_clear, preserve metadata and descriptor binding through normal async function. Concurrent same-key misses explicitly may compute separately, no singleflight. Keys are hashable args+sorted kwargs including method self, normal result/argument retention until eviction/clear. Default synchronous lru_cache unchanged.

Add separate wrapt.ttl_cache.ttl_cache(ttl,maxsize=128,clock=monotonic). Use finite explicit nonnegative TTL from successful computation COMPLETION, maxsize bounded LRU and global expired-entry purge on call/info; zero TTL/maxsize disables storing. Add independent wrapt.canonical_cache.canonical_cache(maxsize=128,typed=False,key_func=None). inspect.signature.bind/apply_defaults before key creation so equivalent positional/keyword/explicit-default calls share, varargs remain ordered and varkw keys sort deterministically. typed mode includes direct bound value types.
